body: A KLM Boeing 777-200, registration PH-BQB, operating flight KL-701 from Amsterdam, Netherlands, to Buenos Aires Ezeiza, Argentina, had lined up runway 24 and was cleared for takeoff when the crew accelerated the engines and a loud bang was heard. The crew aborted the takeoff.

The aircraft vacated the runway via taxiway B and returned to the apron. The tower cancelled the takeoff clearance for the next aircraft, and a subsequent runway inspection did not find any debris on the runway. The crew told passengers they had aborted the departure because of a loud bang on the right-hand side of the aircraft, and later told air traffic control they thought the left side had been affected but were not very sure. Emergency services reported seeing one engine about 100 degrees C hotter than normal.
The entire rotation, including the further sector to Santiago, Chile, was cancelled. The aircraft was still on the ground in Amsterdam about 19 hours after the rejected takeoff.
en.summary: A KLM Boeing 777 aborted its takeoff at Amsterdam after a loud bang from the engines during acceleration; the whole rotation was cancelled and the aircraft was still on the ground about 19 hours later.
en.title: KLM Boeing 777 aborts takeoff at Amsterdam after loud engine bang

facts.claim: A KLM Boeing 777-200, registration PH-BQB, operating flight KL-701 from Amsterdam to Buenos Aires Ezeiza, had lined up runway 24 and was cleared for takeoff when the crew accelerated the engines (GE90) and a loud bang was heard; the crew aborted takeoff.

The aircraft vacated the runway via taxiway B and returned to the apron; a subsequent runway inspection did not find any debris on the runway, and the tower cancelled the takeoff clearance for the next aircraft.

The crew told passengers they had aborted the departure because of a loud bang at the right hand side of the aircraft; shortly thereafter the crew informed ATC they thought the left side had been affected but were not very sure, and emergency services reported seeing the engine about 100 degrees C hotter than normal.
The entire rotation including the further sector to Santiago, Chile, was cancelled, and the aircraft was still on the ground in Amsterdam about 19 hours after the rejected takeoff.

body: 荷蘭皇家航空一架波音777-200客機，註冊編號PH-BQB，執行KL-701班機自荷蘭阿姆斯特丹飛往阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯埃塞薩機場。航機已對正24跑道並獲准起飛，機組加速發動機（GE90）時傳出巨響，隨即中斷起飛。
航機經B滑行道脫離跑道，返回停機坪。航管隨後取消下一架航機的起飛許可；跑道檢查未在跑道上發現碎片。機組向乘客說明，因機身右側傳出巨響而中斷起飛，現正檢查原因；隨後向航管表示，疑似左側引擎出問題，但並不確定。緊急服務人員回報，其中一具發動機溫度比正常高約攝氏100度。
整段往返行程，包括續飛智利聖地牙哥的航段，均已取消。事發約19小時後，航機仍停留在阿姆斯特丹。
zh.summary: 荷蘭皇家航空一架波音777在阿姆斯特丹加速起飛時引擎傳出巨響，機組中斷起飛並返回停機坪；整段往返行程取消，事發約19小時後航機仍停在阿姆斯特丹。
zh.title: 荷航波音777阿姆斯特丹中斷起飛　引擎巨響後航班取消
